outcome: MRI features (placental bulge, T2 dark bands, placental heterogeneity, abnormal intraplacental vascularity, focal exophytic mass, bladder wall interruption)
cohort: The study included 262 patients with surgically or pathologically confirmed placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) disorders and normal placentas.
finding: Placental bulge was the only MRI sign found to differ significantly based on placental location, while other MRI features varied across different subtypes of PAS disorders.
